name: ourcrowdh
description: Press Mentions Monitoring — wraps the backend and frontend packages

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --kill-others-on-fail "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix backend && npm run type-check --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
